games.name: Call of Duty: Mobile
games.gameplay: A high-octane mobile shooter packed with classic COD multiplayer, intense ranked modes, and a massive Battle Royale. Expect fast reflexes, flashy gunfights, iconic maps, and action so nonstop your thumbs might ask for a break 😅🔫

games.name: Modern Combat 5
games.gameplay: A cinematic military FPS focused on tactical shooting, cover-based combat, and squad teamwork. Includes a full story campaign and jetpack-powered moments that make you feel like an action movie star 🎬🪖

faqs.question: Which game offers better graphics?
faqs.answer: Call of Duty: Mobile clearly wins with modern visuals, smoother animations, and HDR effects 🎮✨

faqs.question: Which game is better for casual players?
faqs.answer: Modern Combat 5 is easier to jump into thanks to its slower pace and simpler mechanics 😎

faqs.question: Which game is more competitive?
faqs.answer: COD Mobile shines with ranked leagues, esports support, and intense multiplayer modes 🏆

faqs.question: Which game runs better on low-end devices?
faqs.answer: Modern Combat 5 is lighter and more forgiving on older phones 📱
